entity_help.public_charging:
When a public charging session ends (charge port/cable used away from home), Public charging session done turns on and you get a notification.
• Enter the total amount in Public charging session cost.
• The session is added to the charging history about 1 min after entering it.
• Enter -1 to ignore the session.
entity_help.forced_charging:
Forced charging can be enabled manually when the battery level is under the daily minimum.
• Charging: charges up to the daily minimum ({min_daily_battery_level} %).
• Cost control: no charging in the most expensive hours (see the attribute expensive_hours).
entity_help.manual_charging:
Manual charging starts charging at once without waiting for the plan.
• Allow manual charging now: charges with max current from the grid and solar.
• Solar only: charges only with the solar surplus.
Both are turned off automatically when the car is plugged in again.
entity_help.cheap_targets:
Charge targets at cheap prices:
• Very cheap target ({charge_very_cheap_battery_level} %): when the price is under the cheapest price of the last 14 days.
• Ultra cheap target ({charge_ultra_cheap_battery_level} %): when the price is 25 % under the cheapest price of the last 14 days.
The targets follow the expected solar surplus of the coming week.
entity_help.trip:
Trip charging is planned automatically when:
• Trip charge percent is above 0 %, or Trip range needed is above 0 km.
• Trip departure and Trip homecoming are set in the future.
It charges what the trip needs (from the percent or the distance). Charging between {max_recommended_charge_limit_battery_level}-100 % happens just before departure to protect the battery.
Trip reset clears the trip; it is also reset automatically 2 hours after departure.
entity_help.solar_charging:
Enabled when there is solar surplus.
• Charging: uses the surplus; switches between 1 and 3 phases depending on it.
• Need: follows the surplus compared to the house consumption. Max charge {max_recommended_charge_limit_battery_level} %.
• Plan: the expected surplus of the week is used by Optimal weekly charging and Work plan charging, so the car charges as much solar as possible.
entity_help.fill_up:
Optimal weekly charging can be used on holiday (ignores the work plan).
• Charging: spread over a week.
• Need: the difference between the current battery level and the max recommended ({max_recommended_charge_limit_battery_level} %) is split in 3 parts.
• Plan: finds the cheapest hours. The typical daily distance ({typical_daily_distance} km) is used for days without work.
entity_help.deactivate_script: The charger and the car are not controlled by Cable Juice Planner and work normally (the action is charge with max current).
entity_help.workplan:
Work plan charging: enable when you work within the next week.
• Charging: plans daily charging over a week from workdays and days off.
• Need: uses departure and homecoming time and the distance of every workday. Minimum battery level at homecoming {min_daily_battery_level} %, max charge {max_recommended_charge_limit_battery_level} %.
• Plan: picks the cheapest hours from now until the departure of the workday, so the car is always ready.
entity_help.full_charge: Recommended full charge: with an LFP battery a full charge is recommended at least every 14 days or as the car maker says. Set the number of days here; the last full charge is registered automatically.
entity_help.charging_loss:
Charging loss calculation – best result when charging from a low level (e.g. 10 %) to 100 %:
1. Discharge the car as much as possible (max 20 %).
2. Set the wanted charge limit in the car and Max recommended charge limit (now {max_recommended_charge_limit_battery_level} %, at least 90 %).
3. Turn on Calculate charging loss and let the car report when it is full.
4. The result is saved in the options automatically and you get a notification.
entity_help.cheap_limits:
Charge level at cheap prices:
• Cheap: when the price is under the lowest daily average of the last period, charge to {very_cheap_grid_charging_max_battery_level} %.
• Extra cheap: when the price is another 25 % lower, charge to {ultra_cheap_grid_charging_max_battery_level} %.
Optimal weekly charging must be enabled.
entity_help.battery_preheat:
Battery level and preheating settings:
• Minimum daily battery level ({min_daily_battery_level} %): at homecoming from work.
• Minimum trip battery level ({min_trip_battery_level} %): at homecoming from a trip.
• Minimum charge limit ({min_charge_limit_battery_level} %): the lowest charge limit the car allows.
• Max recommended charge limit ({max_recommended_charge_limit_battery_level} %): the car maker's recommendation.
• Preheat X min before ({preheat_minutes_before} min): preheat before leaving for work and trips (the preheat switch per weekday).
entity_help.solar_sell_price: Fixed sell price for the solar surplus. Set it to -1 to use the current hourly sell price.
entity_help.powerwall:
Home battery settings:
• Solar surplus only charges the car when the home battery is above the limit (now {ev_charge_after_powerwall_battery_level} %).
• Use the home battery for the car: needs Solar charging and Home battery discharge above needed turned on; only energy above the limit is used.
Create an automation that disables home battery discharging while the car charges, and only allows it when the switch is on and the battery is above the limit.
entity_help.virtual_ev:
Virtual EV (without a car integration):
• Battery level: set the current battery level of the car when you plug it in.
• Completed battery level: the level the car stops at.
• Estimated total range: the realistic max range of the car.
